# Sales-to-Delivery Handoff

> Owns the Aleysian sales-to-delivery handoff, both sides of the seam: the handoff package assembled at signature from the executed SOW, quote, and deal record, and the incoming delivery team's 12-section handoff brief accepted before kickoff, with its readiness view, week-one discovery agenda, and definition of done.

**What it does.** Owns the Aleysian sales-to-delivery handoff at signature: the handoff package built from the executed SOW, quote, and deal record, and the incoming delivery handoff brief accepted before kickoff.

**Use it when.** A deal signs and someone asks for the handoff package, the delivery handoff brief, the warm transfer, what delivery inherits, or what was promised on a signed deal.

**Not for.** Do NOT use for technical deliverability judgment (solution-brief), the kickoff meeting or project charter (aleysian-delivery-kickoff), requirements extraction (requirements-capture), or pre-sale research and call prep (call-prep).
